name: untrusted-legacy-function-and-unresolved-tool
description: The legacy role "function" message is named search_web by its name field, which matches the untrusted_tools glob search_*: its item is kept, marked untrusted, and still counted before dedup. The tool message's tool_call_id matches no assistant tool call, so it has no name, which search_* does not match: a trusted item (how a bare * glob treats an unresolved name is not pinned here). Both get positional ids.
